evidence.detail: R87 GpuRenderer is the only exact-v308 owner: during GPU startup it creates and schedules this Runnable only when the live Client is already in its logged-in/active state.

run() switches the client canvas into GPU repaint mode, refreshes client GPU state, and when the renderer compute mode is not NONE invokes the renderer scene/buffer rebuild path followed by the GL error check.
After the GPU scene refresh, the task invokes the two client refresh/redraw methods used by the startup path and owns no recurring loop or independent state.

RuneLite GpuPlugin startup contains the same canvas.setIgnoreRepaint(true) and 'Error starting GPU plugin' lineage and, when GameState is LOGGED_IN, invokes the explicitly named startupWorldLoad() lifecycle at this same startup point.

proposals.note: GpuStartupWorldLoadTask is a conservative descriptive recovery anchored by the exact logged-in GPU startup path and corroborating RuneLite startupWorldLoad lineage.
